title: 不行人間キャラクター設定
next_chapter_hook: 内門使者の那双深い瞳が影の中で微かに細められた。陈機のこの一連の無意に見える行動は、彼の中で既に全く異なる輪郭をそっと描き出していた。そしてこの輪郭は、天青宗が最も他人に見られたくない禁忌に触れていた。

text.content:
陳機が思索している間、雑役居の外に突然重い足音が传来し、親しみのある傲慢な笑い声が伴う——韓烈が直にやって来たのだ。

その笑い声は枯れ葉を輻轢する雷のように、牙が痒くなるほど傲慢だった。「陳廃物！本日少爺は天青宗を通りがかったのだ、どうせお前のような廃物中の廃物がどれほど惨めな日々を送っているか見物に来てやったぞ！」扉板は蹴りつけられ開けられ、眩しい陽光が薄い屋内へと流れ込み、陳機の那张平静如水の顔をより一層愚鈍に見せた。

陳技術は瞬きし、夢から目覚めた雛鳥のように、慌てて古い木板の寝台から転げ落ちた。彼一身灰だらけの雑役袍子、膝の布は既に擦り減って白くなり、草屑と塵にまみれている。

「韓……韓师兄？」彼は声が震え、唇をわななかせ、閻王に出合った冤魂のように目を泳がせる，「您怎么……俺は、俺はすぐ师兄のためにお茶を！）

dialogue.content: お茶を？お前のような廃物が少爺にお茶を淹れる資格があるか？」韓烈は地にうずくまった陳機を見下ろし、眼中には軽蔑しかなかった，「お前が少爺が今どんな境界か知っているか？筑基後期！玄武宗同輩第一人者！それはお前は？練気三層、少爺の指一本すら受け止められん！）

text.content:
陳技術は頭を垂れ、両肩が粉粉震え、狂風に吹かれる枯れ葉のようだった。しかし彼の口元は微かに上扬した——誰も見ていなかった。

よし、筑基後期。悪くない。この間玄武宗の資源が随分お前に注がれたな。ただ……この筑基後期の気配，怎麼飘得这么虚浮？根基不稳，强行催谷上来的吧？陳技術は心中で冷笑し，脸上依旧是那副可怜兮兮的模样.

韓烈の뒤에는 несколько учеников из Сюаньу Цзун, каждый из которых вёл себя высокомерно. Среди них был один молодой человек с козлиной бородкой, который сделал шаг вперёд — Цянь Доudo, младший брат главного ученика внутренней секты Сюаньу Цзун. Этот человек пользовался репутацией «попирающего других ради собственного возвышения» в Сюаньу Цзун и был мастером использовать слабых как трамплин для демонстрации собственного величия.

«Господин Хань, какой смысл вам лично приходить к такому отребью?» — ехидно ухмыльнулся Цянь Додо. — «Позвольте мне преподать ему урок, чтобы он понял, что такое небо и земля!»

Цянь Додо strutted forward with an arrogant gait, looking down at Chen Ji: "So this is the famous waste Chen Ji of Tianqing Sect. Indeed, the worst of wastes—even worse than a waste!"

He casually placed his right foot on Chen Ji's shoulder and ground it down. "Come on, bark for me. Bark nicely and I might let you off!"

Chen Ji still cowered, his eyes filled with fear—at least that's how it appeared.

Chen Ji raised his trembling head like a mouse with its tail stepped on, stammering: "M-Master Qian, you're so magnanimous, this lowly one was wrong, this lowly one won't dare again..."

His voice was the most humble, the most pitiful. However, the moment he looked up, a deep light flickered in his eyes—like a hunter gazing at prey.

Three breaths. Three breaths was all he needed to crush this jumping clown's ankle bones into pieces.

But... was it worth it?

choice.prompt: While Qian Duoduo was swaggering and putting more and more pressure on Chen Ji's shoulder with his foot—how should he respond?

choices.description: Maintain the waste persona, let them get carried away and reveal more flaws
choices.visible_reward: Make the enemy even more arrogant, accumulating rage for the later reversal
choices.risk_hint: Physical pain is nothing to Chen Ji
choices.process_label: 陈机继续蜷缩着身子，瑟瑟发抖

text.content: Chen Ji continued playing his waste role, constantly begging, his body shrinking lower and lower, just like a mouse being toyed with by a cat. Qian Duoduo's smile grew more brilliant, his foot on Chen Ji's shoulder pressing harder and harder, as if he could already see himself boasting about this scene in front of his Xuanwu Sect colleagues.

choices.description: Let them know why flowers bloom so red, while still maintaining the facade of the waste persona
choices.visible_cost: Might expose part of his strength
choices.visible_reward: Intimidate the minor troublemakers, making them hesitant
choices.risk_hint: Excessive display might draw unnecessary attention
choices.process_label: 陈机指尖微动，一缕霊力悄然溢出

text.content: At the moment Qian Duoduo's foot was about to grind down again, Chen Ji's body suddenly slipped—the movement looked flustered but was precisely positioned to avoid the vital spot. Qian Duoduo's foot landed on empty air, his body lurching forward with a cry of "Aiyo," falling flat on his face and knocking out two front teeth on the spot.

Chen Ji chose to continue acting.

Seeing that Chen Ji didn't even dare resist, Qian Duoduo's interest peaked. He squatted down, grabbed Chen Ji by the collar and lifted him up: "This is it? A waste is a waste—even the courage to fight back is lacking!"

His voice was sharp and piercing, carrying a twisted pleasure. Several Xuanwu Sect disciples around laughed mockingly, some even started heckling: "Senior Qian, step on him a couple more times! Make him bark like a dog!"

Chen Ji was lifted by his collar, feet dangling, his expression still appearing terrified. However, his peripheral vision swept toward the door—

Not far away, behind an ancient pine, a cyan figure stood motionless. That was... the attire of an Inner Sect envoy.

Chen Ji's heart stirred. Perfect timing.

He deliberately struggled a couple times, his sleeve inadvertently slipping down to reveal a faint spiritual pattern on his wrist—the protective formation that the Tianji Record Fragment automatically created at critical moments, flashing briefly before vanishing, but was sharply caught by that cyan figure.

dialogue.content: Enough." Han Lie finally spoke, his voice carrying impatience. "Just a waste— what's the point of having fun. Qian Duoduo, don't waste time here.

text.content:
Qian Duoduo was having too much fun to give up. He flung Chen Ji to the ground, raising his foot to trample Chen Ji's face: "Senior Han, you go ahead, your disciple will catch up! Today if I don't trample this waste's face into the mud, I swear I'm not human!"

Chen Ji lay sprawled on the ground, dust covering his cheeks, looking utterly disheveled.

Deep in his eyes, however, was absolute calm.

You've got some nerve, huh?

choice.prompt: Qian Duoduo's foot is about to step on Chen Ji's face—this time, continue acting?

choices.description: Show mercy and give Qian Duoduo an exit, also gaining a reputation for being "kind-hearted"
choices.visible_reward: The waste persona becomes more solid, while gaining a "cowardly but kind" reputation
choices.risk_hint: This person might become even more insufferable
choices.process_label: 陈机任由那一脚落下，在最后关头侧身避开要害

text.content: Qian Duoduo's foot fell heavily, but at the last moment it veered off—Chen Ji had "conveniently" turned his face sideways. The foot grazed past his ear and slammed into the ground, shattering the bricks. Qian Duoduo couldn't stop his momentum, stumbling and falling right at Chen Ji's feet, his posture so awkward it looked like he was performing a kneeling salute.

choices.text: Trample until he doubts his entire existence
choices.description: Since you won't take a hint, don't blame me for being merciless—let him know the difference between heaven and earth
choices.visible_reward: Completely shatter Qian Duoduo's dao heart, making him avoid Chen Ji for the rest of his life
choices.risk_hint: Too much commotion might draw more attention
choices.process_label: 陈机嘴角勾起一抹冷笑，右手悄然按在地面

text.content: At the moment Qian Duoduo's foot was about to land, Chen Ji's right hand quietly pressed against the ground. His fingers flicked gently, and a wisp of pure spiritual energy traveled through the gaps in the floor tiles into Qian Duoduo's ankle—that energy was gentle as a spring breeze brushing willows, yet precisely struck the most vulnerable acupoint in his ankle. Qian Duoduo's foot went numb instantly, his body lost balance, and he flew right over Chen Ji's head, crashing into the corner wall and raising a cloud of dust.

Qian Duoduo struggled up from the corner, his forehead bruised and bleeding mixed with dust, looking completely pathetic.

"You... you dare sabotage me, you waste?!" he howled, trembling all over and pointing at Chen Ji.

Chen Ji still lay on the ground, his face full of innocence: "S-Senior Qian, this lowly one did nothing... it was Senior who couldn't stand steadily..."

His voice was extremely wronged, his expression utterly innocent, yet in those eyes was clearly a hint of barely concealed amusement.

The surrounding Xuanwu Sect disciples looked at each other in bewilderment. Clearly it was Qian Duoduo who fell on his own, but something felt off.

Han Lie narrowed his eyes, his gaze sweeping over Chen Ji. Though known for being simple-minded, his instincts were unusually sharp. For this instant, he felt something was wrong about this waste, but he couldn't pinpoint what exactly.

"Waste, you'd better behave." Han Lie snorted coldly, turning to leave.

However, just then, Chen Ji "carelessly" raised his head.

That gaze was calm as a still ancient well, deep as if it could see through the human heart. Han Lie's heart contracted sharply, his steps involuntarily halting.

Just a moment.

The next second, Chen Ji had returned to his timid, trembling self, lowering his head.

Han Lie frowned, shaking his head—it must be his imagination. What threat could a Foundation Building Third Stage waste possibly pose?

"Let's go!" He swept his sleeve and led the group away in grand fashion.

Chen Ji remained on the ground until those footsteps had completely faded. Only then did he leisurely get up, brushing the dust off his clothes.

"Whew... acting is exhausting." He muttered to himself, a meaningful smile curling at his lips. "Qian Duoduo, right? Remember this. That kick, I'll note it down."

He raised his head, his gaze越过 the courtyard wall of the servants' quarters, falling on the direction of that ancient pine—

That cyan figure still stood there motionless.

Chen Ji understood in his heart.

An Inner Sect envoy... Su Qingyao's person.

Interesting. She truly hasn't relaxed her surveillance on him. Only, how much did her person see?

Chen Ji shrugged casually. The Tianji Record's aura had been concealed by him using special methods. Unless someone witnessed him动用《天机录》的力量 directly, there was no way to detect it.

As for that glance just now...

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, his smile deepening.

Always have to give some sweetness, right? Otherwise, how would that woman Su Qingyao become increasingly interested?

Not far away, the cyan figure behind the ancient pine stirred slightly.

The Inner Sect envoy's face remained impassive, but waves were churning in his heart.

That waste... something's off.

He personally witnessed Qian Duoduo inexplicably falling face-first, personally witnessed that eerie switch in Chen Ji's gaze when facing Han Lie. That kind of gaze was absolutely not something a Foundation Building Third Stage waste could possess.

That was... the gaze of a superior.

The gaze of one who controls everything.

The Inner Sect envoy took a deep breath and quietly departed. This news must be reported to Su Qingyao as soon as possible.

Meanwhile, inside the Tianqing Sect's Council Hall.

Ling Yuan sat cross-legged on a meditation cushion with eyes closed, when suddenly he opened his eyes.

In those turbid old eyes, a flash of sharp light flickered.

"Interesting..." he murmured to himself, his withered fingers tapping lightly on the armrest. "The Tianji Record's aura... seems to have flickered again."

A meaningful smile slowly curved his lips.

"Chen Ji... Chen Ji... just who are you?"

Inside the servants' quarters, Chen Ji suddenly shivered.

He raised his head, gazing toward the direction of the Council Hall, his eyes darkening.

Someone was watching him.

And this sense of being watched... didn't come from Su Qingyao's people.

It came from somewhere higher.

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, that carefree smile on his face gradually fading, replaced by a deep coldness.

Ling Yuan... old fox, you're indeed not staying idle.

He gently exhaled, restoring his slovenly appearance, and hummed a tune as he walked back into his decrepit little room.

No problem. Come then.

If you want to watch a show, I'll put on a show for you.

Just whose play it will be in the end—that remains to be seen.

Chen Ji closed the door and took out a dim jade slip from his chest.

This was his secret communication token with Ye Qing.

He infused spiritual energy into it, and several lines of text appeared on its surface:

"Xuanwu Sect activity frequent, major event likely imminent. Tianji Record Fragment's aura increasingly obvious, exercise extra caution. — Ye Qing"

After reading, Chen Ji fell silent for a moment. Then, spiritual flames flickered from his fingertips, incinerating the information on the jade slip into ash.

"Interesting..." he murmured. "Looks like this game is getting more and more lively."

Outside the window, the setting sun slanted westward, dying the Tianqing Sect in golden-red.

Chen Ji stood before the window, watching the darkening horizon, his gaze deep as an abyss.

Han Lie's provocation was just a beginning.

Qian Duoduo's humiliation was merely an appetizer.

The real storm was still to come.

He slowly clenched his fist, and on his palm, a mysterious pattern flickered faintly.

Heavenly Fate Value—only seventy-three points remaining.

And he still had many scores to settle.

The Chen family. The Holy Sect. Ling Yuan.

And that Eye of Heaven's Way lurking in the shadows.

One by one, then.

A cold smile curved his lips, yet deep in his eyes was icy resolve.

In this life, he would not lose to anyone again.
